pool_name: Geometry-sorted pure-cross-entropy natural-prefix transition fixture search panel
purpose: Search a fixed non-blind panel for one real Smoke A transition event. Every candidate prefix must be generated naturally by the bound source checkpoint. Each eligible harmful prefix receives exactly one fixed bag of eight same-prefix samples. All six images finish before event selection; no per-image seed extension, threshold relaxation, reconstructed prefix, or cross-checkpoint prefix is permitted.

primary_checkpoint.name: Qwen3-VL 2B description-first geometry-sorted pure cross-entropy plus token-type-gate Weight-Decomposed Low-Rank Adaptation checkpoint at step 4887

owner_review_contract.ontology: Common Objects in Context 80 categories only
owner_review_contract.ledger_semantics: All annotated objects are positive owners; absence of an annotation is never negative evidence.
owner_review_contract.covered_owner_update: one clean complete prefix row with exactly one unambiguous physical owner

primary_case_rule.claim_boundary: The chosen event is a functional development fixture only. It cannot estimate rescue frequency, generalization, or training effectiveness.

admission_rule: A Smoke A transition event requires an exact naturally generated prefix from this checkpoint and run, an actual greedy verified covered duplicate or verified premature terminal, and a same-prefix sampled complete row assigned to exactly one verified uncovered physical owner. All generated outcomes are retained. Reconstructed, teacher-forced, manually reordered, cross-checkpoint, ambiguous, mixed-owner, and official-mismatch-only candidates are excluded.
stop_rule: Finish all six fixed images. Select the first passing event by the declared tie-break. If none passes, close this panel without adding images, seeds, relaxing thresholds, or reinterpreting ownership.
